title: The Follies of a Day; or, The Marriage of Figaro A comedy, as it is now performing at the Theatre-Royal, Covent-Garden. From the French of M. de Beaumarchais
summary: "The Follies of a Day; or, The Marriage of Figaro" by Beaumarchais is a comedy written in 1778. But the Count, already bored with marriage, has set his sights on the bride-to-be.
